negative_snippets:
Very Disappointing Stay – Poor Service & Facilities
I booked this hotel for 4 people for 4 days, which included breakfast and dinner, but the overall experience was extremely disappointing.
On arrival, we were given a room where the flush was not working. Despite reporting it immediately, it was only fixed on the second day, causing unnecessary inconvenience. One blanket was missing on a double bed, and even after informing the staff, it was not arranged promptly. The TV in the room was broken and unusable throughout the stay.
The biggest issue was with the food service. The food timing was clearly mentioned as 8:30 AM onwards, but breakfast was not served at all yesterday. Today, we were told breakfast would be served, yet no food was provided even till 9:00 AM. Since we had training at 9:30 AM, we were forced to skip breakfast completely, which is unacceptable when meals are part of the package.
Additionally, the quantity and quality of dinner served yesterday were below standard and not worth what we paid.
Overall, this hotel lacks basic management, hospitality, and accountability. I would not recommend this place to anyone, especially families or professionals who depend on timely service.

Staff was found having dinner at 8:30pm but despite asking for dinner multiple times we only got ours after 10:30pm!
Highly disappointed!

We had a wonderful stay as a couple. The room was clean, comfortable, and provided complete privacy. The atmosphere was peaceful and romantic. The staff were polite and respectful. Overall, it was a lovely experience.
